newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums unchanged, busier volumes.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums unchanged, busier volumes.

text.p: NWE gas oil barge and cargo premiums were unchanged in slightly busier volumes on Wednesday but traders kept a cautious eye on a standoff between the main long and short on the November IPE delivery.
Dec IPE futures firmed $2 to $223.75 a tonne on colder weather in Europe.

Traders said concern over the destination of the record high 865,100 tonnes of physical gas oil due to be delivered out of the November IPE contract continued to hang over the market but business, while still slow, was less hesitant than earlier in the week and some barges were now availale for spot trade.
Monte Carlo-based AIC, the main short, has said Cargill, the domninant long, has been excessively slow in taking delivery of 627,800 tonnes of the oil. Cargill has declined to comment.
On barges, heating oil refinery grade was traded at Dec IPE +$2.50 and low sulphur diesel was done at Dec IPE +$12.50, +$12.75 and +$13 for late November, both unchanged.
On cargoes, heating oil refinery grade was done at Dec IPE+$6.75 basis Bremen ,and low sulphur diesel with wax additive was done at Dec IPE +$18 basis Rostock, both for late November.
